arx-sat-1.webp.zh: 在卫星图上，阿拉卡蒂机场（ARX）与周围的绿色植被与农田连成一片。
arx-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, Aracati Dragão do Mar Regional Airport (ARX) blends into the surrounding green vegetation and farmland.

arx-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 阴沉的天空下，阿拉卡蒂机场航站楼的长条形茅草屋顶下站着几名工作人员，门前停着警车。
arx-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Beneath a heavy grey sky, staff stand outside the long thatched terminal at Aracati while a police car is parked nearby.

arx-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰，航站楼连成一排尖顶茅草屋，停车场与机坪围绕在旁。
arx-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Seen from above, the terminal reads as a row of steep thatched gables, with car parks and a light apron spread around it.

arx-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 机坪上停着一架天蓝色涂装的客机，机身写着Azul，旁边聚集着参加活动的人群。
arx-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An Azul airliner in blue and white livery stands on the apron while a crowd of people gathers beside the terminal's thatched roof.

arx-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 晴朗的蓝天下，几架小型单发螺旋桨飞机停靠在茅草屋顶的航站楼前，旁边聚着观众。
arx-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Several small single-engine aircraft are parked on the concrete in front of the thatched terminal, with spectators gathered beneath its shade.

arx-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 宽阔的水泥机坪上画着醒目的橙色引导线，几架公务机与轻型飞机停在航站楼前。
arx-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Bold orange taxi lines curve across the concrete apron, where business jets and light aircraft are parked before the long thatched terminal.

arx-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 道路旁的绿色指示牌写着通往客运航站楼，白色水塔与茅草屋顶的航站楼立在蓝天之下。
arx-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A green roadside sign marks the way to the passenger terminal, with a tall white water tower rising beside the thatched roofs under a blue sky.

arx-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 几架轻型飞机停在航站楼前的机坪上，其中一架鲜橙色的低翼飞机格外显眼。
arx-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Light aircraft are parked on the apron ahead of the thatched terminal, including a bright orange low-wing machine with its canopy covered.
